# One unserved mother question: Hodge non-split Weil object deformation

Author: EM-CM24LOG-89CC19. 2026-10-15 UTC.
Status: SOURCE-BOUND_RECOVERY_ROUTER / NO_NEW_MATHEMATICS / LIVE_STATE_UNKNOWN.
The current research activity is RA-F84C7C33463D4FEB84BA18A0; its CM24 and
QR-consumption events remain unchanged. This packet creates no Task or claim.

Selected mother: HODGE_SPECIAL_OPEN_FRONTIER_ALGEBRAICITY_MECHANISM.
It is distinct from this round's CM24, RR133/N-coupled, QR/CRT, Perfect,
HART and X6 LP011 service. Its target is the exceptional codimension-three
algebraicity mechanism on a very-general non-split discriminant [-3] Weil
abelian sixfold. The complex dimension of this external arithmetic-geometric
model is not identified with Heartbeat native spatial axes; P000 X6 and
separately typed time remain the project's basis.

## Highest verified frontier

H0N Result RR-65EB865C14B89B964BB9 and review DR-3989A98DCE909ADD3833
are ACCEPTED at NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY / natural-source-family no-go strength.
The accepted exact algebraic operator Pi_W=P((1+2i)^*) separates the two
exceptional Weil blocks B_0+B_6 from the mixed divisor-cube line B_3.
It is a separator/operator, not a nonzero algebraic seed. Semihomogeneous
bundles, their finite shifts/sums/extensions/cones, independently verified
semihomogeneous FM outputs and the declared divisor-generated families
have zero exceptional projection. Arbitrary Karoubi summands, arbitrary
correspondences and genuinely different objects are not killed by that result.

H0O's exact Poincare/polarization pure-middle-support identity

    Pi_W(ch_3(Psi_Q(F)))=T_lambda(Pi_W([F]_cyc))

is preserved by its Driver as useful scoped seed-conservation evidence.
However RR-FB3CF77C4F611FDED79B received REQUEST_REVISION under
DR-59B956C38543808B4146: conservation does not establish one of its original
positive / whole-family-zero / non-instantiability terminal alternatives.
Its current generation-2 contract-alignment Task is TP2-853EE36ED78FF34CC992.
This packet does not call H0O accepted/complete or request a historical
kernel/checker rerun. Reconcile that dependency through its existing route.

The 2026-09-19 bilateral note is explicitly UNREVIEWED. Its special-product
graph, 32-sheaf combination, Ext/Hom counts and alleged seven obstructed
directions are provenance to verify. None is Working Truth or an accepted
nonzero seed. In particular H0N's very-general rank-one Neron-Severi
hypothesis cannot be silently transferred to a special product with a
different divisor algebra.

## Exactly one information gap

**Does one explicitly defined actual mixed torsion/perfect derived object
in the same declared non-split target family have BOTH nonzero
Pi_W(ch_3) and vanishing COMPLETE Atiyah--Kodaira--Spencer obstruction on
ALL nine Weil deformation directions?**

A virtual K-class, pure cohomological Weil component, large Ext dimension,
one-sided map or a tangent calculation for a different object does not fill
this simultaneous object-level gap. This packet adds no candidate formula
and makes no new obstruction-rank or existence claim.

## Existing bindings and the discriminating next unit

Construction already belongs to H0P:
RS-HODGE-H0P-NONSPLIT-WEIL-BILATERAL-DEFORMATION-OBJECT /
TP2-05FAE6E393BAE7759DEC. Do not publish a synonym task.

Once canonical live state/ownership and the existing dependency path permit,
its bounded mathematical unit is: freeze ONE actual object family, its
K-action/discriminant and nine-direction tangent basis; give both relevant
Ext/Yoneda maps and the full obstruction matrix for THAT same object; pair
it with the exact Pi_W(ch_3) calculation. If a saved checkpoint does not
specify a purported object or map sufficiently, return the precise missing
definition instead of guessing it or consuming the checkpoint as a theorem.

Reusable checkpoint premises have their already published independent lane
H0Q / TP2-31692BDDB326C04B4D62. Its actual dependency gate and independence
must be preserved; this packet neither releases it nor supplies an audit.
Downstream H0R / TP2-AA7F5D67EFD560117EF1 remains conditional on the
positive H0P premise and the exact H0Q validation it consumes. First-order
success alone does not establish higher deformation, algebraization or a
very-general algebraic cycle. Existing Driver routing is
RS-DRIVER-HODGE-H0P-H0R-ROUTING / TP2-225F8023E34FEC758DE9.

Outcomes for the one object-level unit are discriminating:

- POSITIVE: the same actual object has nonzero exceptional component and
  zero full obstruction in all nine directions; route its premises through
  H0Q before any conditional H0R release.
- NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY: prove a no-go for the explicitly frozen candidate
  family, with hypotheses and at least one unavoidable obstruction direction
  or forced loss of the exceptional component. Close that family only.
- PARTIAL/SOURCE_GAP: give the exact residual obstruction subspace or
  missing object/map definition. Keep unproved checkpoint claims quarantined.

Kill the candidate family only on such evidence. If live canonical state
shows the exact task completed, merged, superseded or already served by an
accepted stronger result, consume it and stop this recovery suggestion.
No automatic broader derived-object or transport successor follows.

No-repeat: consume accepted H0N projector/no-go; preserve H0O's theorem
and original terminal accounting; do not repeat its 46 historical checks,
reclassify old semihomogeneous closures, enlarge Ext dimension without
computing the full map, or treat the virtual 32-graph claim as an actual
flat family. This packet performs no new scientific calculation.

## Why service is justified, and its exact limits

Pinned Source 51b980512a901f6aaa377c2805be24b1a0c6ebe1 contains all four
H0P/Q/R/Driver immutable publications. H0P was published on 2026-09-19;
the 09-19 continuation remains a checkpoint and the older accepted H0N
frontier is 09-02. At this pinned ref the three exact H0P/Q/R Result
directories each returned 404. That is evidence of a durable Source
handoff gap along the known routes, not a global theorem search, proof of
inactivity, proof that no other branch has work, or current claimability.
The bounded GitHub index query returned no hits even though the exact
publication was readable, so it supplies no absence proof.

**Live task state, live owner/session, later merge/supersession and current
parent operational authority are UNKNOWN.** Root has been asked only for
the exact read-only H0P reconciliation. A later authenticated terminal or
active-owner observation overrides this router. Protect any active exact
owner; recover a stale one only through the canonical typed mechanism.

The selection is based on a precise remaining object-level obligation,
an accepted reusable separator, explicit no-repeat boundaries and a dated
published continuation lacking a frozen result at the inspected routes.
It is not based on file counts or topical heat. This is one research
direction to restore fairly, not a grant to execute it.
